channel.title: Daily Recap — 🏰 Disney News
channel.description: What happened in 🏰 Disney News, recapped daily from subscribed feeds.

item.title: Disney lays out its parks opening timeline, with Tropical Americas coming in 2027
item.description:
As part of the letter to shareholders closing out fiscal 2026, Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro shared opening timelines for major parks projects in 2027 and beyond, covering Walt Disney World and Disneyland, the cruise ship expansion, and parks in Paris, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Abu Dhabi. The company reiterated that Tropical Americas, the new land coming to Disney's Animal Kingdom, remains on track for 2027.

The timeline gives Disney fans the clearest picture yet of the parks pipeline after years of announcements, and the Tropical Americas confirmation is the headline for Walt Disney World watchers — it anchors the resort's next big expansion. With projects spread across every resort worldwide, the letter frames the coming years as one of the busiest build-outs in Disney parks history.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney Shares Opening Timeline for Parks Projects, Reiterating Tropical Americas in 2027

item.title: Disneyland reveals its 2027 After Dark lineup, with three returning favorites and one new theme
item.description:
Disneyland has announced its 2027 Disneyland After Dark lineup, bringing back three fan-favorite events alongside one all-new theme for a season of evenings dedicated to love, discovery, adventure, and community. The separately ticketed, after-hours events give guests access to Disneyland park and select attractions — often with shorter wait times — along with themed entertainment, food, and character encounters.

After Dark has become a reliable draw for Disneyland, and the mix of returning favorites plus a fresh theme suggests Disney is confident in the formula. Dates and details are now public, so fans can start planning which nights to book — and the new theme gives even regulars a reason to return.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Dates and Details for 2027 Disneyland After Dark Events

item.title: Disney wins four 2027 Thea Awards, including for Space Mountain and Muppets Rock 'n' Roller Coaster
item.description:
The Themed Entertainment Association has announced its 2027 Thea Awards, and Disney took home four trophies — including honors connected to Space Mountain and the Muppets Rock 'n' Roller Coaster. The wins come just a couple of weeks after the industry's annual attractions attendance report, which showed a slight dip for Walt Disney World.

The Thea Awards are the themed-entertainment industry's highest honors, so four wins is a strong showing even against the softer attendance backdrop. For Disney, the awards are a reminder that its attractions still set the standard the rest of the industry is measured against.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney Wins Four 2027 Thea Awards, Including Space Mountain and Muppets Rock ‘n’ Roller Coaster

item.title: McDonald's and Disney team up on Home Alone adult Happy Meals for Christmas
item.description:
Disney is going big for Home Alone's 36th anniversary this holiday season, with a McDonald's partnership bringing adult Happy Meals — plus cool socks — tied to the beloved Christmas movie, and Macaulay Culkin involved in the promotion. The collaboration lands alongside a new Mickey Mouse movie, making it a full-on nostalgia play for the holidays.

Adult Happy Meals have become a proven hit for McDonald's since their debut, and pairing them with one of the most rewatched Christmas films of all time is a natural fit. For elder millennials, it is a direct shot of holiday nostalgia; for Disney, it is another way to keep its catalog working hard during the year's biggest shopping and movie season.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney and McDonald’s Are Cooking Up Cool Socks & Home Alone Adult Happy Meals for Christmas 2026

item.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives tomorrow — and Walt Disney World isn't in it
item.description:
Tomorrow brings the release of Grand Theft Auto 6, arguably the biggest media launch of the year — bigger, by some measures, than even Avengers: Doomsday. But for all the speculation, Walt Disney World and the parks will not appear in the game, despite the Florida setting that had some fans wondering whether a theme-park parody might sneak in.

The news is a mild disappointment for Disney fans who also game, but it was always a long shot: Rockstar builds its own satirical Florida, not a licensed one. Still, with GTA 6 set to dominate the cultural conversation, Disney fans can at least stop wondering — and get back to the parks themselves.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Walt Disney World Isn’t In Grand Theft Auto 6

item.title: Disney World fuels a record fiscal 2026 for US parks
item.description:
The Walt Disney Company reported fourth-quarter and full fiscal year 2026 results, and its Parks & Resorts division posted another record-setting year — with Walt Disney World doing the heavy lifting. Attendance at the US parks rose 3% and resort hotel occupancy climbed 1%, a strong showing in a year when many expected travel demand to cool.

The results matter because the parks have become Disney's financial engine, funding the rest of the company while streaming works toward consistent profitability. The strong numbers also shape forward forecasts: rising attendance and occupancy give Disney room to keep investing in new attractions and to hold pricing power, even as guests keep a close eye on what a Disney vacation costs.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Fuels Record 2026 for US Parks, Increasing Attendance 3% and Hotel Occupancy 1%

item.title: Disney Believe, a new cruise ship, sets sail in late 2027
item.description:
Disney Cruise Line's next ship, the Disney Believe, will set sail in late 2027, Disney confirmed in a new update to the ship's official log. The Believe promises one-of-a-kind venue concepts and entertainment shaped by some of Disney's most beloved stories, including Encanto, Frozen, and Snow White.

The ship is the latest expansion of a cruise fleet Disney has been growing aggressively, betting that its parks-level theming translates to the high seas. For prospective cruisers, the late-2027 debut means bookings will likely open well in advance, and the Encanto and Frozen tie-ins signal Disney is leaning on its biggest animated franchises to differentiate the onboard experience.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Disney Believe Updates: New Disney Cruise Ship Sailing in Late 2027

item.title: New Disney World 3-day, 3-park ticket deal: $109 per day for 2027
item.description:
Walt Disney World has announced a new discounted ticket deal for 2027: a 3-day, 3-park ticket starting at $109 per day, a savings of $200 or more versus standard pricing. The deal covers select visit dates in 2027, giving planners a way to lock in a multi-day trip at a meaningfully lower per-day cost.

As always, the value depends on the fine print — which dates qualify and how the three-park structure fits your plans — but at $109 a day this is one of the more aggressive ticket offers Disney has put out for 2027. Anyone planning a 2027 trip should compare it against regular multi-day pricing and any resort packages before buying, since the savings only hold if the dates and park mix work for you.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: New Disney World 3-Day, 3-Park Ticket Deal for $109 Per Day for 2027!

item.title: Magic Kingdom's lowest crowd day of 2027 revealed
item.description:
A calendar update from Walt Disney World has added one of Magic Kingdom's two slowest days of 2027, and it looks like the easiest low-crowd date of the first half of the year — arguably the best overall, given the compromises that come with the other candidate once party season starts. For crowd-averse planners, this is the date to circle.

The catch, as usual, is that the lowest-crowd days tend to come with trade-offs: shorter hours or limited entertainment on the quietest dates. Still, for anyone flexible on timing, a genuinely empty Magic Kingdom day is worth planning around — shorter waits across the board can turn a good trip into a great one.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Lowest Crowd Day to Visit Magic Kingdom in 2027

item.title: Jollywood Nights is now more fun than Mickey's Very Merry — but not better
item.description:
Disney Tourist Blog argues that Jollywood Nights, Hollywood Studios' holiday party, has become more fun than the Magic Kingdom's beloved Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party, even though it still isn't the better event on paper. Mickey's Very Merry has the iconic parade, fantastic fireworks, time-tested entertainment, and classic Christmas atmosphere. Jollywood Nights is scrappier counterprogramming, but the review finds it delivers more actual fun in the moment.

Part of the appeal is the food. Disney Parks Blog goes behind the scenes of the Jollywood Nights menu, where nearly 80 event-exclusive food and beverage items are on offer, almost 30 of them debuting this year. Every dish has to pass a deceptively difficult test: taste festive, feel glamorous, and still be practical enough to serve thousands of guests during one of the season's most stylish celebrations.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Jollywood Nights is Now More Fun Than Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party, But Not Better
  • Disney Parks Blog: Inside the Making of the Disney Jollywood Nights Menu

item.title: Free Disney World tickets with select 2027 Florida cruises
item.description:
Disney Cruise Line is including Walt Disney World tickets at no additional cost with select sailings out of Florida in 2027. The offer covers specific sailings, dates, and exclusions detailed in the post, along with the fine print and how to stack the free admission with other deals.

It is a notable perk because it bundles two of Disney's biggest Florida products into one trip: a cruise and a park visit, with the park ticket effectively free. The blog frames it as a win-win, giving guests a reason to extend their vacation on land while filling both ships and parks. Anyone considering a 2027 Florida sailing should check whether their dates qualify before booking, since the offer applies only to select sailings.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Free Disney World Tickets for Disney Cruise Line Guests on Florida Sailings in 2027!

item.title: First Christmas movie shot at Disney World heads to Disney+
item.description:
"Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True," the first-ever Christmas movie shot at Walt Disney World, will come to Disney+ and Hulu the day after it airs on the Hallmark Channel. The film is a notable crossover: a Hallmark-style holiday romance filmed on Disney property, then streaming on Disney's own platforms.

Details in the post cover the shooting locations around Walt Disney World, tie-ins with Disney Springs, and an exclusive extended cut. For Disney fans, the draw is seeing the parks play themselves in a Christmas movie; for Hallmark viewers, it is the novelty of the setting. The quick jump from Hallmark to Disney+ means most viewers will not have to wait long, or subscribe to anything new, to watch it.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: New Disney World Christmas Movie Streams on Disney+ Day After Hallmark Channel Debut

item.title: New Sequoia Perch club lounge opening at Disneyland's flagship hotel
item.description:
Nearly two years after first announcing the addition, Disney has revealed that the new Sequoia Perch Club Level Lounge will debut in time for the heart of the holiday season, sitting above the lobby of the flagship hotel at Disneyland Resort. The lounge is a new concierge-level option for guests of Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa, and the post offers a sneak peek at what is coming.

Club-level lounges are a premium upsell aimed at guests who want dedicated service, food, and a quieter base during a park trip, so the timing matters: a holiday-season opening puts it in front of the busiest crowds of the year. It is the latest in a slow rollout of upgrades at the Grand Californian, and the reveal finally puts a date on a project that has been in the works since the original announcement.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney Reveals New Sequoia Perch Club Level Lounge Opening Soon at Disneyland’s Flagship Hotel

item.title: Your guide to Very Merrytime cruises
item.description:
Disney Cruise Line's Very Merrytime cruises bring the holidays to sea on select sailings, with seasonal celebrations for the whole family. Disney Parks Blog's guide walks through what to expect aboard, from festive entertainment and decor to holiday-themed activities that set these sailings apart from the rest of the year.

For families weighing a holiday trip, the appeal is a Christmas experience without the logistics of a park visit: the ship handles the decorations, the shows, and the atmosphere. The guide is a planning starting point, laying out which sailings carry the Very Merrytime designation so guests can book the right dates. It is one of several holiday offerings Disney is pushing this season, alongside the parties and films at the parks.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Your Guide to Very Merrytime Cruises with Disney Cruise Line

item.title: Best and worst days to visit each Disney World park
item.description:
Disney Tourist Blog's updated strategy guide covers the best and worst days of the week to visit each Walt Disney World park in 2026 and 2027, covering Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom. It breaks down when wait times run lowest and highest at each park, with commentary on weekdays versus weekends and how special events shift the picture.

The guide is aimed at planners trying to squeeze the most out of a multi-day trip: picking the right park for the right day can mean noticeably shorter lines for the same ticket. It is a practical, data-informed companion to the holiday-season coverage, and worth a read before locking in park reservations for a 2027 visit.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Best & Worst Days of Week to Visit Every Park at Disney World in 2026 & 2027

item.title: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party is sold out for the entire 2026 holiday season
item.description:
It's the opening weekend of Walt Disney World's holiday season and one week into the 2026 Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party — but already all dates have sold out. The sellout of the marquee Magic Kingdom special event is not surprising, but it confirms just how strong demand is for the after-hours party, with its exclusive entertainment, fireworks, and holiday overlays.

For anyone who missed out, the post also covers crowds and what to expect during the holiday season at the parks. The takeaway for planners: if the party is on your list for a future trip, book the moment dates are released — waiting even a week into the season is now too late.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Mickey’s Very Merry Christmas Party Is Sold Out for Disney World’s 2026 Holiday Season

item.title: Is Tropical Americas still on track to open in late 2027?
item.description:
Imagineering has quietly extended a permit for Tropical Americas to late 2027, suggesting that Antonio's Fiesta de Encanto is a year or more away from opening at Animal Kingdom. The latest update includes recent construction photos and analysis of why Walt Disney World will likely opt for a phased opening of the new land.

For a project that has been one of the most anticipated additions to Animal Kingdom, the permit extension is the clearest signal yet on timing: late 2027 remains the target, but the Encanto attraction may not arrive with the land's first phase. It's a long wait, but the phased approach could mean guests get access to parts of the land sooner than a single grand opening would allow.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Is Tropical Americas On Track to Open in Late 2027?

item.title: Disneyland's Napa Rose brings back à la carte dining after guest complaints
item.description:
Disneyland's top restaurant has reversed one of its most criticized changes. When Napa Rose reopened earlier this year, it dropped its à la carte menu entirely in favor of a prix fixe offering only — a meal that ran over $200 per person, which many guests considered a non-starter for a regular dinner out.

After sustained guest feedback, the restaurant has now restored à la carte options alongside the prix fixe menu. The change matters because Napa Rose has long been the flagship dining experience at the Disneyland Resort, and the prix fixe-only format effectively priced out the casual diners and locals who had made it a repeat-visit favorite. Guests planning a Disneyland trip can once again book a more flexible — and much cheaper — meal there.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Best Disneyland Restaurant Gives in to Guest Requests with New À La Carte Menu, No Longer Prix Fixe Only

item.title: Universal's 2027 Military Freedom Pass is back at $235; more military Disney deals expected
item.description:
Universal Orlando Resort has released its 2027 Military Freedom Pass, the inexpensive multi-park admission option for eligible U.S. service members and their families. The pass starts at just $235 and is valid for more than a full year — from now through December 2027 — making it effectively a discounted annual pass for military families.

The pass covers Universal's parks, and Disney is expected to announce its own updated military ticket deals soon as well, continuing the annual pattern of military discounts at both Orlando resorts. For military families planning a 2027 Orlando trip, the Freedom Pass is one of the best-value tickets available, and it's worth waiting to see Disney's matching offer before buying any other tickets.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Universal Brings Back Cheap Year-Plus Freedom Pass for 2027, More Military Disney Deals Coming Soon

item.title: Every Walt Disney World resort hotel ranked, worst to best, for 2026–2027 trips
item.description:
A comprehensive ranking of every hotel at Walt Disney World — Values, Moderates, Deluxes, and Villas — has been updated for trips this year and into 2027. The ranking weighs theme, amenities, location, transportation, pools, dining, and guest rooms to sort the full lineup from worst to best.

For anyone planning a Disney trip, the ranking is a useful starting point for the perennial trade-off: a Deluxe resort gets you closer to the parks and better perks, but may mean fewer park days or skipping Lightning Lanes and table-service meals. The updated list reflects current conditions across the resort, so it's worth a look before booking, especially if you're weighing a Moderate upgrade or a Deluxe splurge for a 2027 vacation.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: All Disney World Resort Hotels Ranked From Worst to Best

item.title: Early Black Friday 2026 deals for Disney fans are already live
item.description:
The holiday season is unofficially underway at Walt Disney World and Disneyland, and early Black Friday sales have started rolling out. A roundup of the best early deals for Disney fans covers books, LEGOs, clothing, and more, with an emphasis on the items Disney fans actually buy.

With Amazon's Holiday Deals event among the early starters, the best discounts are appearing before the traditional Black Friday rush — good news for anyone shopping for Disney gifts, since the most popular items tend to sell out before the official sale weekend. The roundup will keep updating as more deals appear, so it's worth checking back before buying.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Best Early Black Friday 2026 Deals for Disney Fans!

item.title: 2026 Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party guide: dates, prices, and is it worth it?
item.description:
Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party, Magic Kingdom's after-hours holiday event running through November and December, has a freshly updated guide for 2026. It covers dates, ticket prices, strategy, and a review of whether the event is worth the money, based on fifteen years of attending annually.

The party is one of Disney World's most popular seasonal upcharges, with exclusive entertainment, treats, and shorter lines — but the ticket price keeps climbing, so the value question matters more each year. If you're considering a holiday trip, the guide's strategy tips on which nights to pick and how to plan your evening are worth reading before you buy, since the best dates sell out well ahead of the event.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: 2026 Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party Guide

item.title: Holidays at Disneyland kick off today, running through January 6
item.description:
The holiday season officially arrives at Disneyland Resort today, November 13, and runs through January 6, 2027. The parks are decked out in lights and ornaments, with seasonal entertainment and festive food and merchandise across both parks and the resort hotels.

Characters are dressed in their holiday finest throughout the season, making it a prime window for festive photos and character encounters. If you're planning a visit, the holiday programming is now in full swing — the guides lay out what's on, where to find it, and which characters to look for.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Guide to Holidays at the Disneyland Resort 2026
  • Disney Parks Blog: 2026 Holiday Characters to Spot at Disneyland

item.title: Where to meet Santa at Disney World this holiday season
item.description:
Santa Claus is making the rounds at Walt Disney World this holiday season, with meet-and-greet stops across all four theme parks and Disney Springs. The resort is leaning into the festive atmosphere with thousands of lights and holiday music to match.

If a Santa photo is on your family's must-do list, check the guide for which parks he's visiting and where to find him — appearances are spread across the resort rather than confined to a single spot, so a little planning goes a long way.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Where to Meet Santa at Disney World This Holiday Season

item.title: Life Day merchandise arrives for Star Wars fans on November 17
item.description:
Star Wars Life Day falls next Tuesday, November 17, and Disney is marking the Wookiee holiday — a celebration of family, harmony, and joy first introduced in the 1978 Star Wars Holiday Special — with a new line of merchandise at the Disney Store and in the parks.

Expect the red Life Day robes, festive decor, and lights that have become the holiday's signature. It's a niche but beloved corner of Star Wars fandom, and the merch drop gives collectors and Galaxy's Edge visitors something new to hunt for ahead of the day itself.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Star Wars Life Day Merchandise Coming to Disney Store and Disney Parks

item.title: Droid Depot: build and customize your own droid at Galaxy's Edge
item.description:
Droid Depot in Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge remains one of the parks' signature hands-on experiences, letting guests build and customize their own astromech or protocol droid from a parts wall spanning the saga's droid designs — from battered protocol units to the unlikely heroes of Kashyyyk and Naboo.

It's both a souvenir and an activity: you pick the parts, assemble the droid, and take home a one-of-a-kind companion. For anyone visiting Galaxy's Edge at Disneyland or Disney World, it's worth knowing the experience exists before you arrive, since builds are popular and slots can fill up.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Build, Customize, and Collect: Droid Depot at Disneyland and Disney World

item.title: How much of Magic Kingdom is actually behind construction walls
item.description:
A crane towers over Magic Kingdom and construction walls stretch from Liberty Square to Frontierland as Disney builds Piston Peak National Park and Villains Land — two of the biggest expansions in the park's history. A new look at the work as of late 2026 maps out just how much of the park is affected and what guests will actually notice.

The short version: the construction footprint is real and visible, but much of the park remains open and operating normally. If you're visiting soon, it's worth knowing which areas are walled off so you can plan around them — and what the reimagined lands will eventually bring.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Here's How Much of Magic Kingdom Is Actually Impacted by Construction

item.title: Bryan Cranston leaks Carousel of Progress reopening: May 2027
item.description:
While making a surprise appearance at EPCOT for a tequila tasting event, actor Bryan Cranston leaked that the reimagined Carousel of Progress will reopen at Magic Kingdom in May 2027. Cranston is one of the celebrities lending their voice to the updated attraction, which is being reworked with new scenes and talent.

The leak gives fans the first firm timeline for the return of one of Walt Disney World's most storied attractions. The reimagining has been closely watched because Carousel of Progress is a piece of Disney history — a Walt-era show — and how Disney updates it without losing its charm is the question every fan is asking.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Bryan Cranston Leaks When Reimagined Carousel of Progress Will Open at Magic Kingdom

item.title: Star Wars turns 50 in 2027, with reimagined park offerings and new merch
item.description:
Star Wars will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2027, and Disney is planning "reimagined" offerings at Walt Disney World, Disneyland, and Disney Cruise Line. In a preview shared 50 days before the milestone year begins, Lucasfilm and Disney laid out what fans can expect across the parks and the cruise line.

The celebration also brings a new wave of anniversary merchandise, with Disney previewing products tied to the 50-year milestone. Star Wars debuted in 1977 and has grown into a global cultural phenomenon, and Disney is clearly treating the 50th as a parks-wide event rather than a single celebration.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney Parks "Reimaginings" for Star Wars 50th Anniversary in 2027
  • Disney Parks Blog: The Force Connects Us: Celebrating 50 Years of Star Wars with New Products

item.title: EPCOT Festival of the Holidays: full menus, 98 new items, and a Figment popcorn bucket
item.description:
Walt Disney World has released full menus and food photos for the 2026 EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays, running November 27 through December 30, 2026. The lineup covers 98 new dishes, desserts, and drinks across 20 Holiday Kitchens, plus returning items — and the first-ever Figment popcorn bucket, with the dragon sporting a not-so-ugly Christmas sweater.

The festival celebrates holiday traditions from around the world with festive flavors and entertainment throughout EPCOT. With nearly 100 new items, this year's food lineup is being billed as arguably the best ever, and the Figment bucket is likely to be the collectible everyone queues for.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Full Food Menus for 2026 EPCOT Festival of the Holidays: Figment Christmas Popcorn Bucket and 98 New Items!
  • Disney Parks Blog: Disney Eats: Foodie Guide to EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays 2026

item.title: 2027 Moonlight Magic dates revealed for Disney World — nothing for Disneyland
item.description:
Disney Vacation Club is bringing back the free Moonlight Magic after-hours parties to Walt Disney World in 2027, with dates at EPCOT, Animal Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Typhoon Lagoon. During these parties, DVC members can experience the parks after hours with shorter lines and special entertainment.

The catch: there are no nights at the castle parks on either coast, and nothing at Disneyland Resort at all. For DVC members, the 2027 calendar is good news for Florida trips — but Disneyland members are left out entirely this year.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: 2027 Moonlight Magic Party Dates & Registration Revealed for Disney World, Nothing for Disneyland

item.title: Disneyland unwraps its holiday entertainment: parades, fireworks, and ride overlays
item.description:
Disneyland is rolling out its full holiday entertainment lineup: Christmas songs along the Main Street, U.S.A. parade route, fireworks lighting up the night sky above Sleeping Beauty's Winter Castle, beloved holiday ride overlays, and a lineup of new seasonal menu items.

The holidays at Disneyland lean heavily on atmosphere — the castle, the parade, and the music — and this year's program pairs the returning favorites with fresh food offerings. For anyone planning a December visit, the parade and fireworks are the centerpieces, with the overlays and menus rounding out the seasonal offering.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Disneyland Holiday Entertainment: Christmas Parade, Fireworks, and More

item.title: Disney celebrates 100 years of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
item.description:
The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has long marked the official start of the holiday season for many Americans, and in 2026 the storied spectacle turns 100. Disney is joining the centennial celebration, with festivities tied to the milestone across its experiences.

The parade has been seen by generations of viewers, and its 100th year is a natural moment for Disney — whose characters and floats have been part of the tradition — to mark the occasion. Details of Disney's specific contributions are part of the broader centennial programming.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: How Disney is Celebrating 100 Years of The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade

item.title: Disney conservation hits 2 million sea turtle hatchlings at Vero Beach
item.description:
After more than 20 years of conservation work, the Disney Conservation team has estimated that over 2 million hatchlings have emerged from nests laid on the beaches along Disney's Vero Beach Resort, a Disney Vacation Club property. The milestone was made possible by the cast members who monitor and protect the nests season after season.

Two million hatchlings is a remarkable number for a single stretch of coastline, and it puts Disney's conservation work in perspective: the resort's beach program has quietly become one of the more significant sea turtle efforts in Florida. The story centers the cast members whose patient, nightly work made it happen.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Meet the Disney Cast Members Behind 2 Million Sea Turtle Hatchlings

item.title: Imagineers add new props to Remy's Ratatouille Adventure to hide screen seams
item.description:
Remy's Ratatouille Adventure at EPCOT has received new set-dressing in more show scenes to conceal screen seams, and Imagineering has shared a look at the changes along with some of the Easter eggs hidden in the attraction.

The ride has long drawn criticism for moments where the screen edges break the illusion, so the new props are a targeted fix: physical set pieces that keep guests inside the world rather than reminding them they're looking at a screen. It's a small, craft-level change, but it shows Imagineering still iterating on a ride years after it opened.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Imagineers Add More New Props to Remy's Ratatouille Adventure at EPCOT to Help Suspend Disbelief
